sens_en: to raise, to stick up, to warp
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi écrit 翹 et le glose « longues plumes de la queue » : 羽, la plume, pour le sens, et 堯 pour le son. Simplifié, 堯 devient 尧, lu yáo, loin de qiào, et 羽 s'écrit comme 习. Des plumes de queue qui se dressent : relever, dresser, 翘尾巴.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi writes 翹 and glosses it as “long tail feathers”: 羽, feather, for the meaning, and 堯 for the sound. Simplified, 堯 becomes 尧, read yáo, far from qiào, and 羽 is written like 习. Tail feathers sticking up: to raise, to stick up, 翘尾巴.

mots.en: to stick up, to tilt up

phrase.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu qiào zhe wěiba pǎo lai le.
phrase.fr: Le petit chien arrive en courant, la queue dressée.
phrase.en: The puppy came running with its tail up.
